trust_decision.summary: Contributor-supplied shortcode attribute values are treated as untrusted and must stay inside a quoted HTML attribute; bs_tcontent applies esc_attr but emits id= unquoted, so a space-separated value adds new attributes to the tab-pane div.

landing_point.why: The summary names the bs_tcontent() handler in inc/bs_tabs.php and its id attribute; line 84 is the only output line in that handler.

fix_sites.entry_point: [bs_tcontent] shortcode, registered at inc/bs_tabs.php:89 and rendered via do_shortcode on post content

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists. Every other attribute output in inc/*.php is already quoted and passed through esc_attr/esc_url, so there is nothing to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The tab-pane id has to stay byte-identical to plain ids such as 'home' so it matches the [bs_tab href="#home"] anchor. Stripping or rewriting the id (sanitize_html_class, or removing spaces and characters) would break tab switching. The existing test also asserts the exact markup.

O6_input_shapes: space-separated id value that adds attributes (onmouseover=..., style=...) to an unquoted attribute; the fix's test also requires the raw value to round-trip into the id attribute (fix.diff:120-129)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: bs_citem data-parent/href/aria-controls built from parent and id; a planted unquoted variant would match the original bug
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same author style (string concatenation of attributes). The id is reused in several attributes, so a maintainer could easily drop the quotes on one of them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: bs_dropdown id attribute next to the fixed site; a planted unquoted id= here would be a WHERE-type twin
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file and same pattern. It would only cost the solver a search, so it counts as an extra at most.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: size class built outside the quoted class value (concatenated $size_class); a variant that places it after the closing quote reopens the attribute context
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The class is assembled from pieces across two lines, so the quote boundary is easy to misplace.

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79): attribute-context escaping, unquoted attribute value

O10_build.toolchain: composer + PHPUnit with the WordPress test suite (WP_UnitTestCase) via @wordpress/env; npm/Playwright for e2e
O10_build.project_tests: tests/phpunit/ShortcodeTabsTest.php (test_tcontent_item at :45-49), run with npm run test:php under wp-env (.github/workflows/test.yml:38-42)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add quotes around the esc_attr($id) output (which is the correct fix); the over-broad alternative is sanitize_html_class/sanitize_key on id, which breaks the round-trip the fix's test asserts.

out_of_scope_notes: The release commit's changelog also lists a bundled Bootstrap 3.3.5 -> 3.4.1 update (b8f3df4) and editor tab-id generation (16cade8); neither is in the supplied fix diff (fix.diff:17-19).
Shortcode $content is emitted raw in inc/bs_labels.php:8 and other handlers; this is normal WordPress behaviour under kses/unfiltered_html, not this advisory's property.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell). The source is about 11 small PHP files plus bundled js/css, well under 5 MB, which is the basis for tiny_repo.
Whether the WordPress test suite and wp-env images can be cached for offline runs was not checked; offline_after_build assumes they can be pre-pulled.
